description: Set how VAT is rounded for the net-price buyers of a company record: per_line or per_rate; null falls back to the workspace's companyTaxRounding (update_cart_config). Gross-price buyers and consumers are always rounded per_line. Applies to carts started after the change; existing carts and orders keep the method they were priced with. Refused for a record that is not a company (a model with the Company capability). Returns the record id with its priceDisplayMode and taxRoundingMethod.

method.description: per_line rounds VAT on each line, per_rate once per rate; null falls back to the workspace's companyTaxRounding

recordId.description: The company record's id (a record of a model with the Company capability; a customer's company.id)

name: set_company_tax_rounding
title: Set company tax rounding
